Hello @FcoJavierSainz, what command are you using to build the project? Furthermore, are you building the quarkus repo itself or are you building some project which uses Quarkus?

The error says:

```
Failed to build quarkus application: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Unable to resolve locale: c.u-US -> [Help 1]
```
Do you know where/who is setting that locale?

Finally, as the error message says, if you pass `-X` to the `mvn` command it will display a lot more information including stacktraces which can help understand what's going on. If you can run it with that option, please paste us those details.

@FcoJavierSainz, would you happen to know what/who is passing that `c.u-US` locale? Can you also post the output of:

```
./mvnw --version
```
It looks like your IBM Cloud toolchain is set to that locale? What is returned when you `echo $LANG` in that environment?

Hello these are the outputs
```bash
echo "lang $LANG"
./mvnw --version
-----
lang C.UTF-8
Apache Maven 3.6.3 (cecedd343002696d0abb50b32b541b8a6ba2883f)
```

Looks like `C.UTF-8` is a special "Computer" locale. I think we could change `LocaleConverter` to use `Locale.ROOT` in this case, let me check. 

In the meantime, can you see if you can make it work by changing your locale to something else?

issue.title: Make LocaleConverter more lenient

issue.body:
This is necessary in environments where the C.UTF-8 locale is used (like in IBM Cloud toolchain environments).

Fixes #11430

body: I provided a fix in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/11499, can you build from my branch and see if that works for you?
